recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-12398. Address FHIR-54375 separately when Resolved - change required issues are in scope, since it should refine Medication.ingredient.role wording without removing or weakening isActive.
issue_request: FHIR-12398 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting a Medication.product.ingredient.isActive 0..1 boolean to identify whether an ingredient affects the drug's therapeutic action.
initial_application: Commit 6ef7a79e5d50d39ae6d127dc66cada986d958001 added Medication.product.ingredient.isActive to the Medication spreadsheet. Commit b0500f8b520d72851aba346483f21d1ded9a86b3 later removed the Medication.product backbone and moved the element to Medication.ingredient.isActive, and commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried it into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Medication is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Pharmacy decisions and discussions did not reverse FHIR-12398: FHIR-36048 declined replacing the boolean flag, FHIR-46607 added a complementary role CodeableConcept, and FHIR-54375 is a separate Resolved - change required cleanup for the role definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml already defines Medication.ingredient.isActive as a 0..1 boolean with the requested therapeutic-action definition and true/false requirements.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same 2017 Medication commit for open-world ingredient comments; not audited here because this result is scoped to the active/inactive flag.
Resolved - No Change decision declined replacing Medication.ingredient.isActive with a role element.
Applied R6 change added Medication.ingredient.role as a complementary CodeableConcept usable with isActive.
Resolved - change required issue asks to clean up the role definition; it is outside this applied/published seed scope and does not negate FHIR-12398.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring a Medication.product.ingredient.isActive 0..1 boolean to distinguish active and inactive ingredients.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed requirement and the intended true/false semantics.

evidence_items.summary: Current Medication.ingredient source includes active/inactive comments and Medication.ingredient.isActive as a 0..1 boolean with the therapeutic-action definition and true/false requirements.
evidence_items.learned: The current authoritative source already carries the FHIR-12398 semantics.

evidence_items.summary: Original TR#12398 commit added Medication.product.ingredient.isActive to the Medication spreadsheet with the requested boolean semantics.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was historically applied as Jira requested.

evidence_items.summary: Later source history moved Medication.product.ingredient.isActive to Medication.ingredient.isActive and then converted spreadsheet source into the current StructureDefinition XML.
evidence_items.learned: The path and file-format differences are expected refactors, not missing application.

evidence_items.summary: Later Pharmacy issues considered ingredient roles: FHIR-36048 declined replacing isActive, FHIR-46607 added role as a companion to isActive, and FHIR-54375 is a separate role-definition cleanup request.
evidence_items.learned: Later decisions do not remove or alter the FHIR-12398 isActive requirement in this run's scope.

evidence_items.summary: 2022 discussions explored replacing or extending isActive, but emphasized retaining the core boolean so systems that do not understand extensions or role detail do not lose known active/inactive information.
evidence_items.learned: Community evidence supports retaining the FHIR-12398 flag and treating role detail as complementary.

evidence_items.summary: Pharmacy minutes record a 10-0-0 motion on FHIR-54375 to update Medication.ingredient.role wording while acknowledging isActive remains a separate element.
evidence_items.learned: The later work is a role-definition cleanup rather than a reversal of the FHIR-12398 flag.

evidence_items.summary: Commands confirmed Medication.ingredient.isActive in current source and medication=Medication under active [resources].
